implementation: New educational scalar FV implementation; no third-party solver code copied.
reference: Analytic polynomial cell averages and Fourier-antiderivative periodic means; separate Gauss12 point-function quadrature. No independent PDE engine run.
unit_convention: Dimensionless unit interval and speed1; epsilon has squared solution units. Fixed epsilon values therefore depend on amplitude/units. h² means the explicit coefficient1 at the fixed unit amplitude.
originality_limits: Baseline WENO-JS and WENO-Z power2, not the new embedded methods in van Lith2017 or original finite-difference Borges experiments.
